```{r}
source("scripts/build_seminar_data.R")

gwas_all_sessions <- recurring_topic_engagement %>%
  filter(str_detect(seminar_title, "GWAS")) %>%
  pull(attendees_all_sessions)

microbiome_all_sessions <- recurring_topic_engagement %>%
  filter(str_detect(seminar_title, "Microbiome")) %>%
  pull(attendees_all_sessions)
```

The [Bioconductor Africa Seminar Series](https://training.bioconductor.org/seminars/bioc-africa/) supports the growth of the Bioconductor community in Africa while remaining open to participants worldwide. This page summarises the programme's reach, participation and continued engagement.

**Sessions to date:** `r total_sessions`  
**Topics covered:** `r total_topics`  
**Last updated:** `r generated_on`

# At a glance

Across `r total_sessions` sessions, the series has attracted `r total_unique_registrants` unique registrants, with more than one-third of unique attendees participating in multiple sessions.

**Unique registrants:** `r total_unique_registrants`  
**Unique attendees (by email address):** `r total_unique_audience_attendees`  
**Attended two or more sessions:** `r total_repeat_session_attendees` (`r sprintf("%.1f%%", repeat_session_percentage)` of unique attendees)  
**Attended two or more topics:** `r total_cross_topic_attendees` (`r sprintf("%.1f%%", cross_topic_percentage)` of unique attendees)

# Geographic reach

## Registrations

These maps show registrants across all available registration reports, deduplicated by email address. Someone who registered for more than one topic, or for a recurring meeting with several sessions, is counted once.

**Registrants with country information:** `r mapped_unique_registrants` of `r total_unique_registrants`

::: {.panel-tabset}

interactive_map_registrants_africa

## Attendance

These maps show unique attendees across all available sessions, deduplicated by email address. Known AI notetakers are excluded.

**Attendees with country information:** `r mapped_unique_audience_attendees` of `r total_unique_audience_attendees`

::: {.panel-tabset}

# Continued engagement

Multi-session topics showed strong continued engagement, including `r gwas_all_sessions` attendees who joined both GWAS sessions and `r microbiome_all_sessions` who completed all three microbiome sessions.

Unique and repeat-attendance measures are based on attendees who could be identified consistently by email address. A small number of attendees without a consistent identifier are excluded. Repeat-attendance measures also exclude the organising team.

```{r}
if (nrow(recurring_topic_engagement) > 0) {
  recurring_summary <- recurring_topic_engagement %>%
    transmute(
      `Recurring topic` = seminar_title,
      Sessions = occurrence_total,
      `Attended two or more sessions` = attendees_two_or_more,
      `Attended all sessions` = attendees_all_sessions
    )

  knitr::kable(
    recurring_summary,
    caption = "Engagement within recurring topic series"
  )
}
```

# Participation by session

Attendance is deduplicated within each session, with known AI notetakers excluded. For recurring meetings, registrations are cumulative up to the date of each session.

```{r}
seminar_summary <- seminar_data %>%
  transmute(
    Seminar = seminar_display_title,
    Date = format(file_date, "%d %B %Y"),
    `Registrations by session date` = total_registrants,
    Attendees = total_attendees,
    `Attendees with country information` = attendees_mapped
  )

knitr::kable(seminar_summary)
```
